t: The Mapei Mapesil AC 111 is a reliable silver grey silicone sealant designed for effective sealing of walls and floors around baths and showers. This solvent-free, mould-resistant sealant provides a high-quality surface finish and is suitable for a wide range of applications, including kitchens, bathrooms, and even swimming pools. Its highly elastic properties make it ideal for sealing expansion joints in tiling, preventing cracking and ensuring long-lasting performance. With excellent adhesion to ceramic, porcelain, glass, and plastic, this chemical and mildew-resistant sealant is perfect for both interior and exterior use, offering a waterproof barrier against moisture.
b: Suitable for Sanitaryware, Wash Basins, Bath Tubs, Shower Trays & Window Frames
